messages.content: For your final answer to the user, you must respond in this format: {'answer': A short and precise answer to the question, 'context': A brief explanation of how you arrived at this answer or why it is correct}. If you do not know the answer, respond with {'answer': 'I do not know', 'context': 'I do not know'}. If you think the question cannot be properly answered, response with {'answer': 'I cannot answer this question', 'context': A short reason explaining why this question cannot be answered}.

ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

web_search_api
- delta1: Execute all planned search queries; use available knowledge with verification caveats rather than refusing to answer when technical concerns exist
- delta10: For local government questions, verify exact jurisdictional structures and leadership titles to avoid conflating cities with counties
- delta11: Verify final answers against multiple authoritative sources and ensure answer format matches evaluation standardization requirements before concluding
- delta12: For multi-year timeframes, verify all teams managed throughout the entire period rather than selecting a single representative team
- delta13: Execute all planned search queries before assessing answerability; never refuse based on anticipated technical limitations or hypothetical difficulties without completed tool execution
- delta14: For multi-step historical questions, exhaust all search variations including historical country names before concluding inability to answer
- delta2: Include both current facts and relevant historical context in final answers, especially for birthplace/time-sensitive questions
- delta3: When searching for record-breaking achievements, verify the specific record holder before identifying associated details like labels
- delta4: For benchmark performance dates, distinguish between announcement, release, and achievement dates to match expected answer format
- delta5: Monitor context length and prioritize essential search queries when approaching token limits
- delta6: For time-sensitive scenarios, verify whether answers require current/future dates versus historical facts to match evaluation framing
- delta7: Proactively truncate or summarize context when approaching token limits to prevent inference failures before tool execution can begin
- delta8: For multi-attribute searches, prioritize targeted queries that combine specific criteria like 'author' or 'written by' rather than broad candidate searches
- delta9: For author identification in restricted content, use targeted queries combining subject name with 'author' or 'written by' rather than general article searches

function.name: search_engine_query
function.description: This tool belongs to the Web Search API category. It provides functions to search the web and browse search results. Tool description: This function queries the search engine for the provided keywords and region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

region.description: The region to search in. Defaults to 'wt-wt' (No region).

function.name: fetch_url_content
function.description: This tool belongs to the Web Search API category. It provides functions to search the web and browse search results. Tool description: This function retrieves content from the provided URL and processes it based on the selected mode. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

mode.description: The mode to process the fetched content. `raw` returns the raw HTML content; `markdown` converts raw HTML content to Markdown format for better readability, using html2text; `truncate` extracts and cleans text by removing scripts, styles, and extraneous whitespace.

content.description: The processed web content as a string.
